# Agentdock

> An easy-to-use TypeScript wrapper around LangGraph for building production-ready AI agents.

Agentdock gives TypeScript applications a clear API for model configuration, typed tools, approvals, sessions, persistence, lifecycle control, and normalized streaming events. LangGraph provides the durable orchestration underneath; application code uses Agentdock APIs instead of importing LangChain provider classes directly.

## Documentation

- [Installation](/docs/installation): Install Agentdock, its model package, and Zod.
- [Quickstart](/docs/quickstart): Create an agent, register a typed tool, and run it.
- [Models](/docs/models): Configure OpenAI, Ollama, or OpenRouter through `AgentDockModel`.
- [Tools](/docs/tools): Define focused, validated tools with Zod.
- [Run and stream](/docs/runs): Run an agent or consume its events as they arrive.
- [Approvals](/docs/approvals): Pause sensitive tools for approval and authorization checks.
- [Sessions](/docs/sessions): Continue conversations and protect session access.
- [Save sessions](/docs/checkpoints): Add in-memory or durable checkpoint storage.
- [Context management](/docs/context-management): Summarize long conversations before they exceed a model limit.
- [Events](/docs/events): Process Agentdock's normalized run and message events.
- [API reference](/docs/api-reference): Review the `AgentDock` methods and options.

## Packages

- [`@agentdock-ai/agentdock`](https://github.com/agentdock-ai/agentdock/tree/main/packages/agentdock): Core runtime for agents, tools, runs, approvals, sessions, and streams.
- [`@agentdock-ai/models`](https://github.com/agentdock-ai/agentdock/tree/main/packages/models): Application-facing model configuration for OpenAI, Ollama, and OpenRouter.
- [`@agentdock-ai/contracts`](https://github.com/agentdock-ai/agentdock/tree/main/packages/contracts): Framework-independent event and data contracts.
- [`@agentdock-ai/checkpoint`](https://github.com/agentdock-ai/agentdock/tree/main/packages/checkpoint): Checkpoint adapter contract and in-memory storage.
- [`@agentdock-ai/checkpoint-sqlite`](https://github.com/agentdock-ai/agentdock/tree/main/packages/checkpoint-sqlite): SQLite persistence.
- [`@agentdock-ai/checkpoint-postgres`](https://github.com/agentdock-ai/agentdock/tree/main/packages/checkpoint-postgres): PostgreSQL persistence.
- [`@agentdock-ai/checkpoint-mongodb`](https://github.com/agentdock-ai/agentdock/tree/main/packages/checkpoint-mongodb): MongoDB persistence.
- [`@agentdock-ai/checkpoint-redis`](https://github.com/agentdock-ai/agentdock/tree/main/packages/checkpoint-redis): Redis Stack persistence.
- [Agentdock UI](https://github.com/agentdock-ai/agentdock-ui): Frontend components and hooks, coming soon.

## Runtime requirements

- Node.js 20 or later for the core runtime.
- Node.js 22 or later for `@agentdock-ai/models`.
- TypeScript applications with a server-side provider key.
